name: Grilled salmon
summary: Cá hồi nướng is grilled Thác Bạc salmon, named both on the town grill list and at the restaurant by the falls gate. The national desk says the flesh is firm, tight, rich, and sweet.
origin: Thác Bạc salmon, from the farm the falls page places by turning right at the foot of the fall. A later national piece says the flesh is firm, tight, rich, and sweet, and that it can be cooked many ways.
texture: The national food piece says the flesh is chắc and săn: firm and tight.
taste: The same piece says the fish is béo and ngọt: rich and sweet. That is the fish, not a sauce.
howToEat: Order it at the restaurant the falls page places near the gate, or at the town grills in cold weather. A stall price is Check on arrival.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa, near the gate, and the grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Grilled salmon in Sapa — Thac Bac fish, two places
seoDescription: Cá hồi nướng at the falls restaurant and at the town grills. The national desk calls the flesh firm, tight, rich, and sweet.
